commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Strasbourg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
90+6' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem signals.
90+4' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+4' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

88' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes.
87' Ball possession – 41:59.

73' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' A corner kick by Rennes is thwarted by the well prepared Alaa Bellaarouch (Strasbourg).
71' 1 - 0 Goal! Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
71' A precise first-time shot by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender.

70' Strasbourg slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
68' Desire Doue (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
68' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
67' Rennes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

53' Emanuel Emegha is being substituted because of an injury. Patrick Vieira sends Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) on the pitch.

39' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
37' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
35' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
34' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle after Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
32' Desire Doue (Rennes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.

30' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
27' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

25' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Steve Mandanda pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
23' It must be a yellow card. It is. Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
21' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle and signals a foul after Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) brought his opponent down.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
18' A lofted pass finds Arthur Theate (Rennes) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the right post.
17' Yellow card. Martin Terrier (Rennes) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
16' The possession of the ball – 35:65.
14' Good movement by Andrey Santos (Strasbourg), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
14' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

13' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Rennes are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
10' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Rennes.
9' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows the whistle, Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul.
8' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Steve Mandanda is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
6' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
5' Great teamplay by Strasbourg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Martin Terrier (Rennes) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
